_what: How each retailer link in ops/affiliate-catalogue.csv was verified. Written by ops/product_links.py. 'hits' is how many of the first 24 product slugs the retailer's own search grid returned contained a keyword for the product type; 3 or more is required to publish. The grid is read from a headless Chromium render, not an HTTP fetch: these retailers draw results in JavaScript, and homedepot.com returns 403 to a plain fetch of any URL including its own homepage. A 403 from curl is not evidence about a link.
